name: count contiguous intervals where a series stays at or above a threshold
definition: detect separate runs of consecutive samples whose value stays at or above a threshold for a minimum number of steps and count the runs per series.
failure_mode: miscounting merged or borderline runs fails the exact-count assertions.

name: decompress a printer-file fixture before analysis
definition: expand a compressed printer-file so its contents become readable by the parsing step.
failure_mode: leaving the fixture compressed produces garbage.
